}}'''''Koh-Lanta: Malaisie''''' is the fifteenth season of ''[[Koh-Lanta]]''. It was broadcast on TF1 from November 1, 2012 to February 1, 2013, with each episode airing at 7:45&nbsp;p.m.

[[Ugo Latriche]] defeated [[Brice Martinet]] in a 10-1 [[jury]] vote to become the [[Sole Survivor]].

== Production ==
This season takes place on the archipelago of Seribuat in Johor, Malaysia.

==Twists==
* '''[[Hidden Immunity Idol|Hidden Immunity Necklace]]:''' Necklaces could be played at [[Tribal Council]] after the votes have been cast but before they have been read. All votes cast against the castaway it was played for would not count.
*'''[[Schoolyard Pick]]:''' The two tribes were determined by the man and woman who won the initial challenge.
*'''{{dab|Banishment|Koh-Lanta}}:''' After the Schoolyard Pick on Day 1, four castaways were banished until the Day 4 Reward Challenge, where they would join the two starting tribes.
* '''Black Vote:''' The Black Vote allows a previously eliminated castaway to take revenge by casting a vote against one of the remaining castaways on their tribe. It would count at the castaway's next Tribal Council.
*'''Replacements:''' Due to two [[evacuation]]s, two castaways ([[Élodie Sadeler]] and [[Thierry Villette]]) returned into the game after being voted out.
*'''[[Tied Destinies (twist)|Tied Destinies]]:''' On Day 29, the ten remaining castaways were divided into five pairs by a rock draw. Until the next Tribal Council, the fate of each castaway is linked to their partner: the challenges are competed as pairs, and the castaway voted out at Tribal Council also causes their partner's elimination.
* '''Final''' '''Five:''' Instead of occurring at the final four, the standard orienteering challenge occurred at the final five, with the two losers being eliminated.
